name: Lefetamine
summary: Lefetamine (Santenol) is a drug which is a stimulant and also an analgesic with effects comparable to codeine.

pharmacology.text: Lefetamine (Santenol) is a drug which is a stimulant and also an analgesic with effects comparable to codeine.

uses.text: Some related pyrrylphenylethanones had analgesic activity comparable to morphine. Some pyrrole analogues were reported to have analgesic effects comparable to lefetamine and being devoid of neurotoxic properties.
